nombre_oficial.texto: The Central Garden and the Pyramid

frase_gancho.texto: A plot of land bought to protect Trotsky that became a garden, with a red pyramid.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: You step back into the light. The garden occupies the neighboring lot, one thousand and forty square meters, which was bought in nineteen thirty-seven when Trotsky was living in the house. There are cacti, plants, fountains, and Mesoamerican sculptures. In the middle rises the red pyramid that Diego had built to display pieces from his pre-Hispanic collection outdoors, among the plants.
